name: deepseek-harness
rawDescription: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — open-source agent harness by DeepSeek AI, built on an everything-is-a-plugin architecture powered by Cordis (spatiotemporal composability). TypeScript pnpm monorepo: 50+ packages (core/llm/mcp/sandbox/session/skill/subagent/todo/workflow/goal/plan/guard/boot/host/sdk/...), apps (cli/web), python sdk, native landlock sandbox.
readmeHead: DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI. Everything-is-a-plugin architecture, powered by Cordis. Developer preview, iterating rapidly.
